rationale: Crawl4AI is a comprehensive, production-grade web crawling and scraping framework with 472 Python files across 157 directories. It provides deep coverage across 7 of the 8 pipeline concerns: browser automation (Playwright + undetected-chromedriver via browser_adapter.py), stealth/anti-bot (playwright-stealth, UndetectedAdapter, antibot_detector.py with 3-tier detection), LLM script generation (C4A-Script DSL in script/c4ai_script.py with Lark parser), JSON-LD extraction (async_url_seeder.py _parse_head extracts application/ld+json), self-healing selectors (ContentRelevanceFilter, PruningContentFilter, BM25ContentFilter in content_filter_strategy.py), queue/job scheduling (MemoryAdaptiveDispatcher with RateLimiter in async_dispatcher.py), and fuzzy matching/dedup (cosine similarity in adaptive_crawler.py, URL normalization in domain_mapper.py). Only fulltext-search is not directly implemented (relies on external indexing). The codebase has 213 test files, extensive docs, and active maintenance (v0.9.2 Aug 2025). Architectural depth is high with clean abstraction layers (AsyncCrawlerStrategy, ContentScrapingStrategy, ExtractionStrategy base classes).
limitations: No built-in full-text search index (expects external MeiliSearch/Typesense/Elasticsearch)
Sync/Selenium version deprecated and being removed
Docker API server requires separate deployment for production scale
C4A-Script is Crawl4AI-specific DSL, not portable
LLM extraction depends on external providers (LiteLLM wrapper)
